title: Closing the mobile gender gap in low- and middle-income countries
discussion_signal: GSMA’s post reports that women in LMICs remain less likely than men to use mobile internet and frames progress as slow, uneven, and dependent on targeted investment. It also names AI as a potential source of new digital divides rather than assuming access expansion is sufficient.
linked_research_question: How do affordability, skills, safety, and relevance preserve gendered mobile-internet gaps despite expanding access?
limits: Adoption gaps do not establish causes for every country
Reported operator commitments are not equivalent to realized use or safety
